title: research: screen rank-4 retimed block calls
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Screens the rank-4 child calls in both orientations of the pinned #1094 gauge44 local program. Fourteen target frames contain either four or seven calls; the verifier retimes only intervening scalar additions whose register references do not touch a later child input. It replaces four independent rank-4 products by a block-diagonal rank-16 product, and three by rank 12. The work is a zero-charge local screen, not a physical supplier.

## Result

The exact source census groups 80 calls into 22 blocks (14 rank-16 and 8 rank-12), preserving all 320 units of rank mass. The standalone ideal ceiling gain is 2.0187%, below the task card's 5% screen. Composing this profile arithmetically with the pinned rank-2/rank-3 zero-charge profile yields a 6.6289% ideal ceiling gain, but still waives the physical input layout, routing, frames, hosting, precision and dirty restoration. No supplier or new kappa is claimed.

## Validation

- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank4-retimed-blocks --check-only`
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank4-retimed-blocks`
- `python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/complex-rank4-retimed-blocks --check-source-history`

The registered replay passed both the pinned predecessor's rank-2/rank-3 screen and this package's archive/member pins, both orientations, exact scalar retiming, symbolic block-diagonal identities, rank-mass and rational ceiling checks.

## Task and overlap

Scientific base: canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. A refreshed text scan at 2026-10-19 10:45 UTC covered 733 open PRs and 2,596 Discussion records. The closest work is selected-word rank-1 batching (#1779) and strict chronological rank-2/rank-3 blocks (#1960/#2014); this screen is limited to same-target-frame rank-4 groups with exact scalar-reference retiming. Text search is not a novelty certificate and does not inspect every code diff or unpublished work.

## Credit

The selected gauge44 word and its source lineage retain their original authorship. The predecessor rank-2/rank-3 result retains its attribution in its package. This scoped rank-4 census and verifier were prepared by Gonzalo Mier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review or formal proof assistant is claimed.

## Open next questions

Can one concrete group (for example target frame 431) be emitted as an actual rank-16 child with its left/right operands, output owners, scratch lifetime and arbitrary-dirty restoration fully specified? Trace its child recipes through producer and consumer, write the block inputs/output map, and price every copy, frame conversion, hosted slot, precision term and restoration operation. The frozen event trace does not currently supply that physical ownership/lifetime contract.
